description: Rotation correctness (item 14): after 2D rotation hover hits correct row, lasso selects correct rows, fit preserves angle, and PNG export is non-blank.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
k = rng.integers(0, 3, 3000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 5, (3, 8))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (3000, 8)), columns=[f'f{i}' for i in range(8)])
df['cat'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]
